defect: The active phase-map workflow treated pairwise LER-curve crossings as the primary boundary statistic. Small seed-trajectory fluctuations repeatedly change adjacent-size difference signs, creating arbitrarily many crossing locations. Bootstrapping those locations measures their instability but does not make them a robust phase statistic.
researcher_direction: Define the operational phase by the average LER scaling direction with code distance: decreasing LER is decodable, increasing LER is undecodable, and the zero of that scaling slope is the boundary.

still_valid: All corrected posterior-LLR raw shot records, cell counts, syndrome-fidelity checks, runtime/source provenance, and decoder metadata.
BP convergence-cap mechanism diagnostics, which compare matched logical outcomes rather than infer a phase from curve crossings.
The two-cohort heterogeneity result as a sampling-fluctuation diagnostic only.
superseded_for_phase_inference: Any finite, ceiling, p_c, or q_c label whose primary support is a pairwise crossing count or location.
evidence_impact.reason: The defect is in the phase statistic and presentation, not the corrected decoder outputs or stored logical-error counts.

replacement_primary_statistic.name: finite-size scaling-flow slope
replacement_primary_statistic.likelihood: Binomial logical-error counts at each measured distance.
replacement_primary_statistic.primary_scope: Fit all available common-source L=7,9,11 honeycomb q-skeleton distances jointly within each measured (p,q) cell; do not reduce the fit to an adjacent-size pair.
replacement_primary_statistic.uncertainty: Resample complete nested-p seed trajectories independently within each distance for 20000 replicates and refit beta.
replacement_primary_statistic.decodability_probability: D(p,q) = Pr[beta(p,q) < 0] over seed-trajectory bootstrap replicates.

classification.decodable_green: central 90% beta interval lies below zero and D(p,q) >= 0.95
classification.undecodable_red: central 90% beta interval lies above zero and D(p,q) <= 0.05

replacement_primary_statistic.boundary: The operational finite-size boundary is beta(p,q)=0, shown only where its bootstrap band and leave-one-distance-out direction are stable.
replacement_primary_statistic.crossing_role: None in primary classification, promotion gates, or the main figure. Historical crossing outputs remain provenance only.

visual_contract.main_panel: A red/green/gray q-p raster of measured cells. Color represents beta sign; saturation represents sign confidence or absolute beta.
visual_contract.boundary: A beta=0 contour with uncertainty band only where supported; no line through unresolved or unmeasured regions.
visual_contract.diagnostics: Separate panels show beta with central-90% intervals, LER-versus-distance fits, convergence, and leave-one-distance-out stability.
visual_contract.forbidden: No crossing markers, crossing-count legend, or crossing-derived phase label in the primary phase map.

acceptance_items.item: Implement the binomial logit slope estimator and trajectory bootstrap with synthetic sign and zero-slope tests.
Reanalyze the validated honeycomb L=7,9,11 q skeleton without any crossing statistic.
Generate the red/green/gray slope-flow phase map and uncertainty diagnostics.
Rewrite active Lab 003 conclusions and presentation metadata from the slope-flow evidence only.
Summarize leave-one-distance-out stability and target unresolved cells by seed-limited versus distance-limited evidence need.

execution_gate: The bounded gray-frontier matrix and preregistered slope-flow analysis are complete. One of ten targets becomes red and nine remain gray; the active map has 81 green, 37 red, and 113 gray cells with one supported local boundary segment. Further compute, q/p expansion, unrestricted L15, square, and continuous-boundary promotion remain gated.
